paragraphs.source_en: Hiroko pulled her head back and looked at him again. His breath was whooshing in his lungs, in and out. In English, in a voice formal but kind, she said, "This is your initiation into the areophany, the celebration of the body of Mars. Welcome to it. We worship this world.
